name: The Clankerville
description: A live pixel office of your Möbius chats and their helper teams.

store.tagline: Watch your Möbius agents work in a little pixel office, answer them with a tap, and see what each one costs.
store.description:
The Clankerville turns your Möbius chats into a live isometric office. Every chat is a character at a desk: it types while it works, waves when it needs you, smokes when something broke, and heads to the coffee corner when it's on a break. Chats that start helpers sit together as a team. The office is a 4-floor building: the busiest agents work on floor 1, and the elevator takes you between floors.

Tap anyone to see what they're doing and what they last said, answer their question with a tap, or send a quick reply. On a computer, Open chat puts the full chat beside the office. Every chat shows what it has cost so far at API prices (on a subscription that's an estimate, not a bill): on its name tag on a computer, and on its card when you tap it, with today's share; and a recap tells you what happened and what it cost yesterday. The sword (press and hold) deletes a chat you're done with, recoverable for 7 days, or dismisses a single helper. A hiring desk starts new chats when you fill out its form, and a Former staff board lets you rehire agents you deleted while Möbius still keeps them, with the days left on each. Each floor hides a surprise, and there's a hidden switch for the curious: pressing it twice stops every working chat, cancelling its helpers and queued messages, until you switch it back on. Only do that if you mean it.

What it does with your access: The Clankerville's service uses your full owner key, so it can do anything you can on your Möbius. Möbius has no narrower permission for seeing and steering agents yet, so the install screen won't list one. It reads your chats, their helpers and their usage records (cost and tokens) to draw the office, and it stops, deletes, messages, starts or brings back a chat only when you use the sword, a quick reply, that switch, the hiring desk or the Former staff board. It talks only to your own Möbius, never to another server, and secret and restart cards always stay in the full chat. Review its updates before you install them. Demo mode shows a sample office if you have no chats yet.
